event_summary: A white textured sheet descends into a shallow dish of blue liquid, folds across the liquid surface, and settles mostly flat while an orange-black object remains overhead.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a shallow white dish containing light blue liquid on a wooden tabletop. A thin white textured rectangular sheet is partly visible above the dish, with an orange-and-black object near its top edge. After a stationary interval, the sheet moves downward into the dish. Its lower edge enters the blue liquid and it briefly stands partly upright. The sheet then bends and collapses into a low arched shape across the liquid before settling mostly on or in the liquid, with a small raised portion remaining near the left side. The orange-and-black object stays above the dish after the sheet has separated from it.

reasons: The dish and blue liquid are clearly visible.
The white sheet and orange-black object are partly cropped at the top edge of the frame.
The sheet is already suspended above the dish before the main motion begins.
